kept.desc: Accessing h.activeLanes.upstream without checking if h.activeLanes exists; will throw if activeLanes is null/undefined — use optional chaining h.activeLanes?.upstream
Test accesses stats?.running which does not exist; Stats has queue.running, not a top-level running field — should be stats?.queue.running.

Three assertions about sourceRef, sourceCommit, and workingTreeFingerprint were removed from the main test and moved to a conditional test that only runs if pinnedBaselineIsReachable — in shallow clones (factory workers), this conditional test is skipped entirely.
Empty catch block silently swallows errors from getPostHogClient — failures in telemetry initialization or network calls are completely hidden from observation.
j.preview properties accessed without null check; if API response lacks preview key, throws TypeError at runtime. Use j?.preview?.hasMapping and j?.preview?.lines
